tools.name: search_lexicons
tools.description: Find ATProtocol lexicons by what their schemas say: descriptions, definition names, field names and known values. Use it when you don't know the NSID. mode "keyword" (default) matches words; mode "semantic" ranks by meaning, so a plain description of what you need works (e.g. 'store a user's reading

tools.name: describe_lexicon
tools.description: Get detailed information about an ATProtocol lexicon schema: its definitions, authority, CID and any published documentation. Use this to understand the structure and format of XRPC methods, records, and other lexicon types.

tools.name: validate_lexicon
tools.description: Validate a lexicon schema and optionally validate data against it. Use this to verify schema correctness and validate records, query params, or procedure inputs against their schemas.

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Check compatibility between two versions of an ATProtocol lexicon schema. Detects breaking vs non-breaking changes and provides migration guidance. Supply either two schema JSON objects directly (from_schema + to_schema), or an NSID with two CIDs to compare stored versions (nsid + from_cid + to_cid)

tools.name: discover_permission_sets
tools.description: Discover which ATProtocol permission-set lexicon schemas cover a given set of collections and/or XRPC methods. Returns matching permission sets with their OAuth scope strings (`include:<nsid>`), useful for determining what OAuth scopes an application needs.
